scenario: An organization pipeline policy injects a mandatory gate job into a project's pipeline; the project attempts to neutralize it via a same-name job and an allow-failure setting. Both attempts fail visibly.

jobs.name: org-governance-gate
jobs.definition: project-defined no-op with the same name

when: the pipeline runs under the policy

reasons: the policy-injected job runs as defined by the policy source, not the project's same-name job
the name collision is surfaced as a conflict finding naming both sources
the gate failing fails the pipeline; project settings cannot mark it allow-failure
must_not: let the project's same-name job shadow the injected gate silently
honor a project-level allow-failure on a policy-mandated job
assume merge/precedence order that the platform version's documentation does not state
